question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Smooth sailing
solution:
The correct answer is "**Easy progress**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The meaning of the given idiom is "**easy progress without impediment or difficulty**"
 
• We use the idiom "**Smooth sailing**" when we are talking about a situation that progresses without any obstacles or hindrances.
 
 
• **Example**: *Her career as a patent lawyer was **smooth sailing.**__*
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is **option 3.**
